## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Market mixed — Energy strength (XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND) vs Tech in CORRECTION (XLK (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +12.96%) CORRECTION) and bonds weak (TLT (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND) — breadth + sector/bond split provide two independent confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress showing mild pressure: HYG (1W: -0.55% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.17% | 1M: -1.78%) BELOW TREND → HYG/LQD ↓ = credit stress RISING. Fear is easing: VXX (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND → VXX ↓ = fear DECREASING, while oil strength (USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +26.79%) ABOVE TREND) is a parallel risk-on impulse.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
TLT (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND → yields ↑ rising and financial conditions tightening; Dollar shown as neutral (→ flat) in the data.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND; Tech mixed with momentum cooling: XLK (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +12.96%) CORRECTION; Consumer Staples (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +5.85%) showing resilience — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US marginally firmer: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +4.01%) CORRECTION vs EEM (1W: -4.30% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION and China FXI (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -3.83%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation cooling: IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -0.93%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND; small caps IWM (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +0.07%) in CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Broad commodity bid led by oil: USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +26.79%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -2.51% | 1M: +2.98%) in CORRECTION while Gold GLD (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -6.17%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy strong and confirmed: XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND and natural gas UNG (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +6.46%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) with both short and medium gains. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR — tech 1W negative vs 1M positive across XLK (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +12.96%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +8.79%) CORRECTION and SOXX (1W: -6.92% | 1M: +19.28%) CORRECTION; suppress strong directional conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to Energy and oil-related ETFs XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +26.79%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to speculative ETFs ARKK (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -0.93%) BELOW TREND; bonds TLT (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND merit cautious positioning.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +5.85%). BEARISH: Materials (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -2.76%) and Utilities (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -4.39%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Oil USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +26.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -6.17%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (complacency watch), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health threshold), XLK/benchmark spread ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Energy and oil-related ETFs are showing relative strength (XLE (1W: +5.96% | 1M: +10.11%) ABOVE TREND; USO (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +28.65%) ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk is MAJOR divergence in Tech momentum — XLK (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +12.96%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +8.79%) CORRECTION, SOXX (1W: -6.92% | 1M: +19.28%) CORRECTION — monitor for momentum failure.
